title: Heim, Dröscher and Hauser's two forms of gravity

tellings.quote: two guys named Rusher and Hauser. Okay. They also believe in two forms of gravity.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a line of German physics running from Burkhard Heim, a physicist, to two later researchers, Dröscher and Hauser. According to Michels, they all believed there are two forms of gravity, not just the one we know. If true, it could offer a theory for how strange craft might fly.
